name: Tom su nuong
summary: Tiger prawns you pick from a night-market stall and have grilled.
origin: Chợ đêm Côn Đảo. Báo Bà Rịa–Vũng Tàu, 16 May 2025.
howToEat: Choose the prawns and have them grilled. The market opens at 17:00 and is busiest from 19:00 to 22:00.
One May 2025 dinner of grilled prawns, steamed crab, lemongrass ốc hương, a seafood hotpot, and garlic tôm mũ ni came to 1,200,000 đồng for five people.
where: Võ Thị Sáu and Phạm Văn Đồng, in the open yard in front of the daily market.
seoTitle: Tom su nuong — grilled tiger prawn in Con Dao
seoDescription: Tôm sú nướng is tiger prawn grilled to order at the Côn Đảo night market, open from 17:00.
